name: Scarlet Assassin (Human Rogue 13/Crimson Assassin 5)

Scarlet Assassin
CR 17

Male human rogue 13/crimson assassin 5

Gear +1 elf bane sawtooth sabre, +1 human bane sawtooth sabre, belt of physical might (Dex and Con) +2, bracers of armor +5, mask of the mantis*, ring of protection +3, spell component pouch, 330 gp
PC Gear + 434,000 gp
